physical_contract.primary_region: deterministic local target/process plus nuisance carriers
physical_contract.nuisance_reference: target-free visual region/stream; algorithm input only
physical_contract.nuisance_truth: independent controller/event log for commanded nuisance family
physical_contract.target_truth: independent programmed target/process schedule or actuator log

regeneration_rule: Any physical source, timing, truth-channel, or setup change requires a new setup_id and a newly hashed trial plan before acquisition.
